function: Joint learned control of AAV trajectory, sensor scheduling and IRS phase shifts to minimize average AoI under a covertness constraint (p. 6).
system: Single-antenna sensors, Bob and Willie; AAV-mounted passive IRS with 20 elements initially, LoS links, 1 MHz bandwidth, carrier frequency not stated (pp. 4, 9).
method: Reinforcement learning: DQN (discrete actions) and DDPG actor-critic (continuous actions), trained online in the simulated environment; networks of 16 hidden layers with 512 neurons (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Own simulator, no dataset or measurements: LoS array-response channels with path-loss exponent 2 for sensor-IRS and IRS-Bob, Rayleigh fading stated for IRS-Willie (pp. 4-5).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in one simulated area; sweeps over sensors (5-25), IRS elements (20-100), phase bits, learning rate; no trained model reused in new conditions (pp. 9-12).
baselines: No non-learned baseline; DQN and DDPG are compared with each other and across IRS phase resolutions (2, 3, 4 bits, continuous) (pp. 10-12).
metrics: Average AoI of the system; training loss and return curves; AAV flight trajectories (pp. 10-12).
q1_support: p. 4: "the channel link from the ground sensor to AAV-IRS can be approximated as a LoS link with high probability". Own LoS array-response channels (IRS-Willie Rayleigh, p. 5); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 11: "Average AoI of system versus the number of ground sensors". Only parameter sweeps are plotted; no model trained in one condition and tested in another is reported, and reuse of a trained model across settings is never stated.
q3_support: p. 11: "Comparing DQN and DDPG". The only comparisons are DQN against DDPG (both used by the paper) and across IRS phase resolutions; no non-learned baseline (random or fixed IRS phases, optimization) is run.
q4_support: p. 9: "consists of 16 hidden layers with the number of neurons in". Only the network architecture is given as a setting; no parameter count, FLOPs, complexity order or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 9: "algorithm on the Pycharm platform". Own simulation; no code or data link, no public channel dataset and no measured data.
notes: Included although borderline: the action vector holds AAV flight angle and speed and sensor selection (above PHY) together with the M IRS phases (PHY), so above_phy does not apply (p. 6). Area 3 also fits (learned IRS phase shifts); area 6 chosen by the tie-break order because the IRS is carried by an AAV (aerial link). Main metric is AoI, not a link-level metric. Table I gives altitude 100 m (p. 9) while p. 6 states 50 m.
